package proto

import (
	"fmt"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

// TestCallOverhead times the register-entry and unified-entry call cost for
// three signatures. Each b_* loops n times calling one callee; the loop
// overhead is identical, so the unified-minus-register delta is the extra cost
// of the unified entry (stack arguments, callee-saved save/restore, the
// split-check prologue). Run pinned and idle for stable numbers.
func TestCallOverhead(t *testing.T) {
	const n = int64(300_000_000)
	// Correctness alongside timing.
	if b_reg_i(0, 1000) != 1000*1001/2 || b_uni_i(0, 1000) != 1000*1001/2 {
		t.Fatal("int benchmark wrong")
	}
	if b_reg_v(0, 1000) != b_uni_v(0, 1000) {
		t.Fatal("jsvalue benchmark mismatch")
	}

	bench := func(f func(uintptr, int64) int64) float64 {
		best := time.Hour
		for r := 0; r < 5; r++ {
			start := time.Now()
			f(0, n)
			if d := time.Since(start); d < best {
				best = d
			}
		}
		return float64(best.Nanoseconds()) / float64(n)
	}
	benchF := func(f func(uintptr, int64) float64) float64 {
		best := time.Hour
		for r := 0; r < 5; r++ {
			start := time.Now()
			f(0, n)
			if d := time.Since(start); d < best {
				best = d
			}
		}
		return float64(best.Nanoseconds()) / float64(n)
	}

	ri, ui := bench(b_reg_i), bench(b_uni_i)
	rd, ud := benchF(b_reg_d), benchF(b_uni_d)
	rv, uv := bench(b_reg_v), bench(b_uni_v)
	fmt.Printf("CALL-OVERHEAD ns/call (min of 5, n=%d)\n", n)
	fmt.Printf("  int(i64,i64)->i64      register=%.3f unified=%.3f delta=%.3f\n", ri, ui, ui-ri)
	fmt.Printf("  double(f64,f64)->f64   register=%.3f unified=%.3f delta=%.3f\n", rd, ud, ud-rd)
	fmt.Printf("  JSValue(i64,i64)->jsv  register=%.3f unified=%.3f delta=%.3f\n", rv, uv, uv-rv)
}
